chapter_seo_title: A Formation on the Brink: Shaoyan Gongzi’s Rage and Whitewater Hound’s Last Gamble
chapter_meta_description: Xue Hongyi flees, ten death warriors die in seconds, and Shaoyan Gongzi unleashes his true power—but can the Whitewater Hound break a Celestial Immortal’s formation before it’s too late?
og_title: A Formation on the Brink: Shaoyan Gongzi’s Rage and Whitewater Hound’s Last Gamble
og_description: With the Qiongqi puppets closing in and the team fracturing, Ji Ning’s spirit-beast reveals a shocking plan to break the immortal array from within.
twitter_title: Formation Breaking Time: Uncle White Steps Up
twitter_description: The puppets just slaughtered ten Wanxiang Adepts. Can Ji Ning’s Whitewater Hound really crack a Celestial Immortal’s formation?

lore_anchors.definition: A powerful, treasure-bodied construct formed by an immortal formation, virtually indestructible and relentless when attacking without a controller.
A top-tier divine beast bloodline at the Wanxiang stage, trained in Fiendgod Body Refining, capable of regenerating wounds instantly and matching a Primal Daoist in combat power.
A portable formation-breaking tool named after the mythical Fuxi, used by formation masters to calculate and counter enemy arrays by disrupting their energy flow.
A high-grade type of terrestrial flame whose power rivals ordinary Heavenly Fire; a rare and potent resource for both refinement and combat.
An expendable combatant trained to fight in synchronized formations with linked minds, often used as cannon fodder by wealthy clans in high-risk trials.
A high-level escape technique that allows a cultivator to instantly flee a formation or trapped space; costly and usually burns a rare treasure or immense energy.
